assets.name: ares-hill-day
assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: native painted background scene for CosyWorld's Greek drama card game.
Input images: references for the established warm painted Greek storybook style, natural stone, coastal water and architectural scale. Create the new place specified below.
Style/medium: finely detailed painterly storybook realism, hand-painted stone and nature, natural daylight, restrained warm earth and blue pigments, soft depth and readable landmarks.
Composition/framing: one wide native landscape PNG, about 1536 by 1024. Eye-level wide establishing camera. Keep the central vertical strip useful when the wide painting is cropped into a 390 by 580 phone view. Place key location landmarks within that centre area. The bottom third is broad clear, nearly level stone or earth ground for the game's separate full-body cast and carried objects. Build location details toward the middle distance and edges. Only the place's architecture, natural landscape and water occupy this environment painting.
Lighting: clear natural daytime with soft warm sunlight and readable stone shadows. This is the daylight base for an exact-camera night sibling.
Output: complete opaque native PNG, with the entire original generated canvas preserved.
Place: Ares Hill, an open rocky court above Athens. A broad limestone outcrop holds a simple open hearing ground. Low irregular stone seats trace a loose semicircle in the middle distance; a few worn rock steps lead to it. The surrounding low roofs of Athens appear below the hill, with a distant classical temple on its raised rock. A few olive branches and dry grasses stay near the side edges. The court feels civic, open and human in scale. Keep the centre foreground broad, clear and walkable for Athena, the accusing chorus and carried objects. The low seats, rocky court edge, distant roofs and temple form clear stable landmarks. The central phone crop shows the hearing ground, low seats and distant city. This place reads as being on Ares Hill.

references.role: Warm limestone, distant roofs and painted depth

assets.processing: Original native PNG copied byte for byte; complete generated canvas preserved

Place: the Taurian Shore, a rocky coast below a Greek-style coastal temple. Broad worn temple steps descend from a modest pale stone portico in the upper left toward the shore. A clear accessible stone landing projects gently into a sheltered inlet at centre-right. The lower third is broad nearly level stone and sandy shore for Thoas, a traveller and carried objects. Sea water is clearly visible across the middle, especially inside the central phone crop. Coastal rocks frame the inlet and a distant dark headland closes the far horizon. The berth beside the landing faces clear open water. This is the open-berth view. Keep the temple steps, landing, inlet water, headland and rock shapes as strong stable landmarks. Place the landing near enough to the central crop that a later moored ship will read at phone width while the water remains visible. Only the shore, temple architecture, landing, rocks, sea and sky occupy the image. This place reads as being on the Taurian Shore.

assets.name: tauris-ship-day
assets.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: native painted occupied-berth background for CosyWorld.
Input image 1 is the Taurian Shore daylight scene and exact camera/landmark edit target. Input image 2 is the identity reference for the same shared Greek ship used elsewhere in the game.
Add that shared Greek ship moored beside the accessible stone landing of image 1, toward the centre-right middle distance. Use the SAME wooden hull, faded red side stripe, curved eye-painted prow pointing right, single mast, ropes and furled cream sail from image 2, scaled naturally to the landing. The moored ship occupies the water beside the landing; the foreground cast ground and broad temple steps stay clear and walkable. Keep visible inlet water inside the central phone crop, with the ship's hull and mast readable near that central crop.
Preserve image 1's entire 1536 by 1024 canvas, exact camera, coastline, temple, steps, landing edge and mooring posts, headland, rocks, plants, waterline, sun angle and all location landmarks. This is the same shore at the same moment with the saved shared ship at its berth. Keep the painterly style, natural daylight and original environment details. Return the full opaque native PNG.

references.role: Native open-berth scene edit target: preserve its camera and all land/landing landmarks
Shared greek-ship identity: same hull, red stripe, curved eye-painted prow, mast and furled sail
